list.moduleOff: The supplier module is not on
list.search: Name, application number or taxpayer id
list.emptyHint: Invite a new supplier: it gets a portal link to fill in its application
list.noMatchHint: Clear the filters or try other words
list.kindExisting: Registered supplier invited to the portal

detail.forbidden: You may not see this application
detail.registryNone: Not checked yet: checked when procurement sends it for approval
detail.vatCancelled: The registry says VAT was cancelled

warning.SAME_TAXID_OTHER_BRANCH: This taxpayer id is registered for another branch
warning.DUPLICATE_NAME: The name looks like a registered supplier

detail.missing: Still missing before it can be sent

source.AI: Read by AI from a document

actions.label: What you can do now
actions.route: Check the registries and send for approval
actions.proofNeeded: The registries could not confirm this supplier. Attach proof (such as a checked company certificate) and send again.
actions.returnHint: The supplier gets an e-mail with this reason
actions.cancelHint: Its contacts can no longer use the portal with it. This cannot be undone.

errors.CONFLICT_VERSION: The application just changed. Reload and try again.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: The application can no longer do this
errors.SUPPLIER_DOCUMENT_UNVERIFIED: A required document is not confirmed yet
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: You took part in this application, so you may not do this
errors.REGISTRY_CEASED: The registry says this business has ceased: it cannot be sent
errors.REGISTRY_PROOF_REQUIRED: The registries could not confirm it: attach proof
errors.APPROVER_NOT_FOUND: No approver found under the DOA. Please tell the administrator.
errors.FAILED: That did not work. Please try again.

edit.title: Fill in the application for the supplier
edit.intro: Every field you fill in is marked as filled in by procurement, and the supplier gets a copy when it is sent
edit.save: Save and go to the next step
edit.submit: Send the application for the supplier
edit.accountKept: Saved, ending {last4}. Type a new one only to change it.
edit.sendIntro: Check what is missing before sending. Once sent, the supplier gets a copy of the values by e-mail.

invite.title: Invite a supplier
invite.intro: A portal link is e-mailed so the contact fills in the application
invite.kindExisting: A registered supplier, to the portal
invite.taxIdHint: 13 digits; a foreign supplier may leave it blank
invite.inviterPhone: The supplier's phone as procurement knows it
invite.inviterPhoneHint: Finance calls this number to confirm the bank account, never one the supplier typed
invite.warningsTitle: Looks like a registered supplier: give a reason before inviting
invite.blocked: This taxpayer id and branch are registered or invited already: {refs}
invite.emailTaken: This e-mail is a contact of another supplier already
invite.taxIdInvalid: The taxpayer id is not valid
invite.taxIdRequired: A Thai supplier has a taxpayer id
